title: Why Expensive Restaurants Removed Dollar Signs

vo.en: Look closely at this menu right now.

visual.description: A close-up of a man's hands opening a sleek leather menu inside a luxurious restaurant.

vo.en: Ever notice why expensive restaurants deleted all dollar signs? It is not just minimalist design.

visual.description: A male designer using a digital stylus to erase currency icons on a tablet screen.

vo.en: Cornell researchers proved that removing currency symbols quietly bypasses your natural spending resistance.

visual.description: A male professor pointing at modern financial charts projected inside a university auditorium.

vo.en: Wait until you see the creepy part. This simple format forces people to spend over five percent more.

visual.description: A waiter placing a gourmet dish onto a wooden table as golden coins stack up beside it.

vo.en: Test yourself. Which price makes you pause: twenty-five dollars with a symbol, or just raw numbers?

visual.description: A man writing two different price tags onto a black chalkboard using white chalk.

vo.en: That dollar symbol triggers real pain in your brain. Without it, your mind treats spending like a game score.

visual.description: A male customer tapping his smart device against a modern credit card payment terminal.

vo.en: Subscribe for daily mind hacks and comment your local burger price, which is why you should...

visual.description: A fast-moving night time-lapse of neon city lights reflected in high-rise windows.
